title: ส่งถึงเธอ (paper plane across the soi)

motif.name: paper plane
motif.what: folded by her, crosses the soi, read by him, sent back: the only thing that moves between the two windows

scenes.shot: close: she folds a note at her window
scenes.motion: fingers fold on the beats, she looks down then turns her head toward his window

scenes.shot: wide: two shophouses facing across the soi
scenes.motion: buildings ink in, the plane leaves her window in an arc

scenes.shot: high: over the soi, wires, a noodle cart, a cat
scenes.motion: the street draws itself on as the plane glides through, slow pan
his head follows the plane in (continuous turn) and he catches it on the downbeat
the plane opens flat, the handwriting draws on
scenes.text: ข้าวเย็นกินด้วยกันไหม?

scenes.motion: he throws it back, it lands with her, the title inks in on the last bar
